scope: Fictional employers and candidate data through the actual baseline, combine, identity resolver, planner, worker merger and official Career-Ops writers. No live scan or application.
failure_modes: A normal PERM label is mistaken for a role-specific sponsorship guarantee.
Unnamed or multi-company groups, empty lists or non-normal statuses enter the allowlist.
Substring, customer/technology mention or unlisted subsidiary is mistaken for the employer.
Case, legal suffix or an explicitly evidenced alias loses a valid employer.
Canonical URL resolution changes posting keys before company filtering.
Non-allowlisted JDs remain in assignments, combined jobs or persisted reports.
Employer filtering destroys raw source evidence or alters source liveness.
Policy changes after baseline/planning are accepted during reuse, merge or commit.
Missing/forged scope audit or missing assignments snapshot bypasses the gate.
A valid allowlisted employer overrides an existing Career-Ops blacklist.
All postings are filtered out and nonempty persistence is falsely claimed.
Ordinary Daily Scan acquires an unintended PERM restriction.
Refreshing the catalog makes an already completed receipt unreadable.
A corrected candidate without its report is accepted as an evaluation-only repair.
A completed PERM report repair reads a refreshed live catalog instead of the frozen snapshot.
A restored report slices the perm- prefix into its date.
